title: Tip from Angela - Dealing with Frustration
section: 20. Boss Level Challenge 2 - The Simon Game
summary: A short study tip after the Simon Game: when a bug or concept has you stuck and frustrated, step away from the screen rather than forcing it.

concepts.heading: Key takeaways
points: Staring at the same code for too long makes it harder, not easier, to spot the problem. A break lets the brain reset.
Sleeping on a problem works: review it before bed and try again the next morning, when fixes often seem obvious.
Physical activity (a walk, a run, a swim) helps clear your head before returning to the code.
Getting stuck is normal for every developer. Avoid beating yourself up; the bug will still be there when you come back fresh.

pitfalls: Grinding on one bug for hours without a break, which usually makes the frustration and the confusion worse.
